card.name: Verbs in old local-history prose
card.fires_on: Auxiliary or passive verbs and nearby small words inside long sentences in old county-history or mission-history writing. The marked word is often be, laid, carried, has or not, just before the main verb or phrase.

modes.description: A helper or participle verb in a formal historical sentence, with the key phrase still to come.
